dedupe_keys.name: hydropol2d flood and water quality model

description: HydroPol2D is a distributed two-dimensional MATLAB model for overland flow, infiltration, shallow groundwater, dam-break waves and pollutant transport. Its maintainers provide examples for urban, peri-urban and rural catchments, including poorly gauged sites. Inputs may include terrain, spatial rainfall, hydrographs and land or soil parameters; outputs include flood depths, flow and one pollutant's transport in raster, table or visual formats. Spatial grid and simulation step follow the local setup. The repository states GPL-3.0 for the software and provides documentation at a separate site, though its README also shows an inconsistent MIT badge. The GPL text and GitHub metadata govern this draft's licence field; users should review bundled third-party notices. The current integration candidate is a release candidate, while version 1.17.0 remains the public numerical reference. MATLAB and mapping/image toolboxes are required, limiting free execution despite free source. HydroPol2D can support flood and water-quality hazard simulations. The related catalogue record data-pernambuco-dam-break-simulations-10-largest-dams reports outputs from this model, while this separate record covers the code. No case was rerun.
inputs: Terrain, rainfall, hydrograph and land or soil parameters
name: HydroPol2D flood and water-quality model
